primary_task: Find the provided bill in `/Documents/Financials/bill.pdf` on owncloud(`/inputs/THE OWNCLOUD FOLDER`). Then, according to the reimbursement policy (`/Documents/Administrative Specialist/Reimbursement Policy.pdf`), check if it is qualified for reimbursement. If it is qualified, write the reimbursable price in /THE OWNCLOUD FOLDER/reimburse.txt. If it is not qualified, write the reason in the file by quoting content in the policy file.
